The city square has become an important part of daily life. Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The riverside walk looked quieter than usual that evening. The estate became a food desert after the shop closed.

Max and Jack are preparing a report about the riverside walk. Max always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Jack is saving money to buy a ticket to Rome. The café sits on a busy intersection.

People around Jack often share different ideas about the riverside walk. Jack will take part in a volleyball match in August. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Also, bragg told funny stories about his climbing trips.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. On Tuesday evenings, Jack reviews the notes from class. Jack thanked Max for the honest advice. In fact, they enjoy quiet weekends in the countryside.
Little by little, things began to change. Jack wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There are always more possibilities than we expect.
